steps.milestone: Inspect the packet capture and examine initial traffic
Filter ICMP traffic and extract packet payload fields
steps.outcome: A sequence of hexadecimal payload fragments was recorded.
steps.evidence_quote: tshark -r GLaDOS_Network.pcapng -Y "icmp" -T fields -e frame.number -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e icmp.type -e icmp.code -e data.data

steps.milestone: Decode and concatenate hexadecimal payload fragments as ASCII
Restrict extraction to ICMP echo requests containing data
steps.evidence_quote: tshark -r GLaDOS_Network.pcapng -Y "icmp.type == 8 and data" -T fields -e frame.number -e data.data
